summary: Implemented an initial path-only worktree discovery cache in ProjectPaths.fs: per-main-checkout single-flight cache, FileSystemWatcher invalidation on Git worktree registration metadata changes, post-resolution generation checks, bounded retry when registration changes during discovery, fail-closed refresh, and NUL-delimited `git worktree list --porcelain -z` parsing. HEAD/branch/dirty/detached state are not cached.
nextAction: Compile and run focused WorktreeTests in Release to catch F# issues, then add process-count and race/failure coverage. If watcher invalidation or Git -z parsing behaves differently on the supported host, adjust before broader equivalence tests.
